responsibility: Lowers Rust `simd_*` intrinsics for the Cranelift backend by validating SIMD operand types and expanding vector operations into explicit lane-wise Cranelift IR. It owns code generation for generic SIMD casts, comparisons, shuffles, reductions, inserts/extracts, masked loads and stores, gathers, scatters, and related operations, while emitting errors and traps for invalid monomorphizations or unknown SIMD intrinsics.
